item.title: Astronomy Olympiad Training Course
item.description: Hi friends! If you're free this Nov/Dec hols, come join our Singapore Astronomy Olympiad (SAO) Intensive Training (23 Nov - 13 Dec)! Lessons are on Mon, Wed, Fri and Sun, spread across 3 weeks and 13 lessons! Designed for Sec 1 to Sec 4 students (of HCI and NYGH) of all skill levels, this 13-lesson online intensive builds your foundation from scratch—starting with essential math and physics before diving into Olympiad-level astronomy topics. Not only will this deepen your knowledge of astronomy, but it will also provide you a good foundation for your physics studies. Our lessons are beginner friendly, and we even have an IOAA GOLD medallist to teach a lesson and share tips! Are YOU 🫵 ready for a stellar time that's OUT OF THIS WORLD 💫?! Sign up for HCNY Astro’s SAO Intensive '26 right now! ☄️🔭 Spots are limited! Sign-up form: https://forms.gle/HeDP5a9Ww4FAFaqm7 Infosheet: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jkCAFr3OcSv2g-QvzMAYkQv_Abyh-bdut507WEDksdQ/edit?usp=sharing Drop a follow! https://www.instagram.com/hcny_astro?psln=MTJwY2VrNmhoOTZ6Yw== About SAO: The Singapore Astronomy Olympiad (SAO) is Singapore’s premier national astronomy competition for secondary school and junior college students. It tests theoretical astrophysics, celestial mechanics, spherical astronomy, and observational/data analysis skills. It serves as the selection pathway for representing Singapore at international competitions like the IOAA (International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics). Thank you! HCNY Astronomy Interest Group
